scope: Portfolio research UI and existing employer-request coverage; no financial-engine changes in this revision.
browser_checks: All four analysis tabs executed with offline example inputs.
Exit filter showed 7 policies for a selected strategy and 21 rows for all strategies; Index summary values changed correctly.
Liquidity events displayed 4 gain amounts with all 3 strategies side by side.
Rebalancing chart showed 3 lines with observed date labels and USD axes.
Changing inputs disabled export and the result filter, and marked old results stale.
Reset restored the default horizon and positions; the form reset method is no longer shadowed by the reset button.
Rebalancing and sampling retained separate position drafts when switching tabs.
An invalid position weight showed a specific error and kept export disabled.
Clicking the active tab retained the current result.
Cohort export downloaded through the browser; all 5 ZIP entries passed CRC integrity checks.
390x844 responsive viewport: no page-level horizontal overflow; results scrolled into view after a successful run.
Default desktop viewport: run button visible with internally scrollable inputs; viewport override reset.
remaining_model_limits: Wash-sale matching across rebalance trades, substitute disposals and household accounts is not implemented.
Exit and gift comparisons use annual aggregate assumptions rather than historical tax-lot paths; estate and gift taxes are excluded.
One-time gain break-even depends on assumed returns/losses and a finite search range; actual proceeds and basis require separate client inputs.
Random sampling is implemented, but authentic point-in-time index membership and delisted-security data have not been supplied.
interpretation: Software verification is not evidence of historical returns, actual tax savings, or complete sponsor acceptance.
